scope: reviewed invariants and current limits; does not add cloud sync or permissions

foreground_updates.scope: same backend/canonical conversation; metadata-only invalidation cursor
foreground_updates.commit: read cursor before snapshots, stable second check, publish all successful resources and original cursor together
foreground_updates.editors: preserve unsent drafts and unknown operation identities; never auto-write or merge
foreground_updates.background: stop polling; foreground single flight with timeouts and failure backoff

chat.request_id: reuse same ID and payload while reconciling
chat.unknown: read status before a user decision; never silently resend

memory.forget_disclosure: related source may be paused; original chat may remain
memory.conflict: 409 memory_version_conflict preserves the editing draft; explicit review before saving again
memory.proposal_confirmation: user decides per proposed memory; preserve an existing saved on/off setting

device_preferences.default_policy: shared/generated defaults for new settings only; never overwrite saved user preferences; system accessibility preferences take priority

followups.delivery: Web foreground and supported desktop/system interfaces require shared claim and immediate recheck; native apps currently passive management only; no cloud/background push
followups.request_id: persist same ID and payload across unknown outcomes; compare server receipt before unlocking
followups.explicit_first_rejection: only first unambiguous 400/422 may release an unused request ID
followups.terminal_receipt: accept matching ID/content/time even when already done or cancelled

recurrence.web: once or daily, with time zone and quiet interval
recurrence.ios_android: once or daily create, complete, pause/resume/cancel with item time zone, optional quiet interval, strict occurrence and receipt identity; SDK/device acceptance pending
recurrence.receipt_identity: request_id, content, original created_due_at, repeat, time_zone, quiet interval and known status

contact.topic: explicit per-item normalized topic, one shared attempt across channels and overlapping windows
contact.expiry: no catch-up when offline, quiet or paused; passive item remains visible
contact.claim: shared server claim then one-time immediate recheck; unknown/failure consumes the chance

companion_boundary.storage: shared local backend, CAS revision required
companion_boundary.today: until next local midnight in explicit IANA zone
companion_boundary.pause: applies to all proactive channels while passive chat and tasks remain
companion_boundary.changes: invalidate all existing contact permissions/claims/queued proposals; resuming does not resurrect them
companion_boundary.defaults: active boundary alone is not permission to contact

mood_diary.source: user explicitly selects both coordinates and optional exact note
mood_diary.model_context: never automatic; explicit bring-to-chat only appends a draft, user still sends
mood_diary.cas: exact ISO updated_at read token; global monotonic version prevents delete/recreate ABA
mood_diary.unknown: immutable mutation body persists; only GET reconciliation; absence after unknown new PUT does not prove it failed
mood_diary.native: manual self report CRUD, date picker, durable draft, explicit chat handoff; native auto suggestion/device inference not implemented
